name.description: The name used to identify this character entity.

hitbox_size.description: The size of the character's collision hitbox in pixels at tile scale, must be multiple of 2

hitbox_distance.description: The distance from the character used to position its hitbox. Unused?

innate_actions.description: The actions (folder names) available to this character by default.

layers.description: The visual layers used to compose the character's appearance.

entity_scale.description: The scale applied when rendering the character entity.
